description: change_crdt with the reset_to transform (SCHEMA.md §4 registry, §4.1 M4). Epoch 1's materialized value ('old') is DISCARDED at the boundary; the seed is the migration default 'fresh' placed at the epoch-2 SchemaEpoch order key (50,0,aa,e2). The only epoch-2 op (a2 @20) is older than the seed, so 'fresh' survives — proving prior state is dropped and the seed sits at the SchemaEpoch key.
